prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Interactive walkthrough redesigns on the finish stage significantly hurt completion rates.
Reordering steps (like deferring sign-in) had no clear effect on conversion.
Adding copy estimates and wait-time info showed no clear effect.
Predictions were consistently too high across all test types, anticipating positive gains where results were neutral or negative.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- choose_path, copy: -0.3% over 1 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -31.0% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: -1.2% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -0.1% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Account Sign-In Session Reassurance: Adds explicit hint copy on the sign-in screen reassuring users that signing in preserves pet save data across re-installs. (why: 8 support emails cited pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Pet Customization Photo Upload Guidance Redesign: Redesigns the upload photos screen to a split layout with explicit framing instructions to prevent generation errors. (why: Adoption has a low conversion rate of 60.9% and support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong.)
2: [choose_path, layout] Path Selection Choice Cards Layout: Changes the choose_path screen layout to card view to clearly highlight path options. (why: The choose_path screen takes a mean time of 514s (median 8s), suggesting decision latency for some users.)
3: [finish, redesign] Simplified Desktop First Spawn Welcome Screen: Redesigns home_intro to a spotlight layout explaining basic pet controls without an interactive tutorial. (why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8% and 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.)
4: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Path Pet Selection Screen Grid Redesign: Redesigns the pick_friend screen using a grid layout with feature badges for easier browsing. (why: Adoption is the biggest funnel leak at 60.9% conversion and 1017s mean time.)
5: [sign_in, copy] Sign-In Error Prevention Headline: Updates sign-in screen headline and hint to clarify sign-in persistence and reduce drop-offs. (why: 2 support tickets reported sign-in stalling or screens failing to appear, and sign_in conversion is 72.9%.)
6: [choose_path, layout] Story Screen Mascot Centered Layout: Updates the initial story screen to a centered layout featuring an encouraging mascot component. (why: First step drop-off is 23.8% (choose_path conversion is 76.2%).)
7: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Quick Overview Screen: Adds a static introduction screen before home_intro summarizing mouse clicks and desktop drag controls. (why: 3 support emails specifically noted post-onboarding confusion regarding controlling or hiding the pet.)
8: [adoption, hint] Adoption Certificate Naming Guidance Hint: Adds a supportive naming hint and badge on the adoption certificate screen to encourage rapid completion. (why: Adoption has the highest friction in the onboarding flow (60.9% conversion).)
